This proposal aims to solve the following problem: We have Hydra as our native state of the art state channel solution, we have partnerchains as our native evolution of sidechains, Midgard aims to be our native evolution of rollups.
The UTxO system is a match made in heaven for rollups.
It allows us to build true L2 rollups that inherit maximal security from Cardano.
This cannot be replicated in account based systems.
